entries.name: Eye-Level Portrait
entries.positive: portrait, straight-on, looking at viewer, face focus
entries.negative: from above, from below, foreshortening, fisheye
entries.notes: Danbooru-style tags for Illustrious. 'portrait' = head and shoulders.

entries.name: Close-Up
entries.negative: full body, wide shot, out of frame
entries.notes: Danbooru-style tags for Illustrious. Use 'extreme close-up' for tighter crops.

entries.name: Bust Shot
entries.negative: full body, cowboy shot, extreme close-up
entries.notes: Danbooru-style tags for Illustrious. 'upper body' is the standard tag for bust framing.

entries.name: Cowboy Shot
entries.negative: close-up, upper body, full body, head out of frame
entries.notes: Danbooru-style tags for Illustrious. 'cowboy shot' is an exact Danbooru tag (mid-thigh up).

entries.name: Full Body
entries.negative: feet out of frame, head out of frame, legs out of frame, close-up, upper body
entries.notes: Danbooru-style tags for Illustrious. Out-of-frame tags are real Danbooru tags and work well as negatives.

entries.name: Wide Establishing
entries.positive: wide shot, scenery, from a distance
entries.notes: Danbooru-style tags for Illustrious. Try 'very wide shot' for an even smaller subject.

entries.name: Low Angle
entries.positive: from below, foreshortening, looking down at viewer
entries.notes: Danbooru-style tags for Illustrious. 'from below' is the Danbooru camera-angle tag.

entries.name: High Angle
entries.notes: Danbooru-style tags for Illustrious. 'from above' is the Danbooru camera-angle tag.

entries.name: Over the Shoulder
entries.positive: from behind, looking back, looking at viewer, over shoulder
entries.notes: Danbooru-style tags for Illustrious. No exact tag exists; this combination approximates it.

entries.name: Three-Quarter View
entries.notes: Danbooru-style tags for Illustrious. Add 'looking at viewer' if you want eye contact.

entries.name: Profile View
entries.negative: straight-on, looking at viewer, from behind
entries.notes: Danbooru-style tags for Illustrious. 'profile' is the Danbooru tag for a side view of the face.

entries.name: Dutch Angle
entries.notes: Danbooru-style tags for Illustrious. 'dutch angle' is an exact Danbooru tag.
